description: Look up a public OCD receipt by its exact receipt_id (format "OCD-RCP-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX"). Free, no payment. Returns the complete signed receipt envelope, or a structured not-found/unavailable reason -- never a guess. A private (unpublished) receipt and an unknown id are indistinguishable, both by design: this never confirms or denies that a private receipt exists.
name: get_receipt
